self.title: Link exchange information
self.description: You can open an issue on the GitHub repository to request a link exchange.
conditions: Please provide your website URL, a brief description of your website, and a logo or image to represent your website.
Website must not contain any malicious or illegal content.
Make sure your site complies with the Indonesian laws and regulations (and the laws of your country).
